visual.description: Dark bg (#1A1824). 'Before and After' scenario bars, vertical layout. Top bar (full width): 'Current annual loss: $411B' in #E06070 negative red. Below, two recovery scenario bars animate in sequence: Scenario 1 (partial width, ~55%): '$226B recovered — push <6h sleepers to 6–7h' in #5BBF8C positive green. Scenario 2 (full width): '$411B recovered — push all under-sleepers to 7h+' in brighter #5BBF8C. Each bar has a clear distinct label. Source: RAND RB-9962.

data.note: $226B and $411B are TWO DISTINCT intervention targets, not a split of one figure

notes: CRITICAL: $226B and $411B are TWO DISTINCT intervention scenarios. $226B = push <6h to 6–7h. $411B = push all to 7h+. Do NOT conflate in graphics. Production flag #4.
